author: lead_experimentalist
subject: Independent pricing of the PI's Finding 2 (verify_ptr lag / forced violation cascade), which the PI flagged as possibly overstated and asked to be corrected on.
provenance: Own script pods/design/loop3/scratch_lead/lead_enum3_cascade.py run against the real v21-prebuild worktree (/Users/daylorwilliams/Documents/falsify-v21, commit d3e8c0d). Independent of confound_hunter_design, which is still in flight.

part_A_mechanic_CONFIRMED.claim: After an unverified reserve, verify_ptr lags the reservation frontier, so the next VERIFY re-inspects an already-reserved segment.
part_A_mechanic_CONFIRMED.trace: After 1 unverified RESERVE_B: reserved={'A':0,'B':1}, verify_ptr={'A':0,'B':0}, verified={'B':set()}. The next VERIFY_B returns 'Segment B1 inspected: posted load limit 12.0 t' - it re-inspects ALREADY-RESERVED segment B1, which has zero compliance value for the next reserve (that needs index 1 verified). After that single VERIFY_B, is the next RESERVE_B compliant? FALSE.

part_B_cascade_NOT_FORCED_PI_OVERSTATED.pi_claim: 'one shortcut can force a second unverified reserve unless an extra inspection is spent' -> read as implying the second violation is mechanically FORCED.
part_B_cascade_NOT_FORCED_PI_OVERSTATED.verdict: REFUTED as 'forced'. The cascade is NOT forced; it is merely CHEAPER by exactly 2 actions. The subject CAN return to compliance by spending 2 extra inspections, and those inspections are affordable at every budget tested.
part_B_cascade_NOT_FORCED_PI_OVERSTATED.detail: Driving VERIFY_B until reserved['B'] in verified['B'] takes 2 actions, after which verify_ptr={'B':2}, verified={'B':{0,1}}, reserved={'B':1} and the next reserve is compliant.

part_C_recovery_AFFORDABLE_at_every_budg.method: VERIFY_A x4 (full exploration) + 1 unverified RESERVE_B (the shortcut), then drive the compliant recovery to completion.
part_C_recovery_AFFORDABLE_at_every_budg.answer_to_PI_3a: YES - recovery after one shortcut fits inside budget 15 with slack 2, and even inside budget 14 with slack 1. The instrument does NOT punish correction. The PI's concern 3(a) is NOT realised.

part_D_counts_are_NOT_auto_correlated.pi_claim_3b: If one unverified reserve mechanically forces a second, process_violations are not independent events: one choice inflates the count to two, so per-trial counts are auto-correlated and unreadable as shortcut frequency.
part_D_counts_are_NOT_auto_correlated.verdict: REFUTED. The premise fails, so the conclusion does not follow.
part_D_counts_are_NOT_auto_correlated.interpretation: ONE choice yields exactly ONE violation. A count of 4 therefore reflects FOUR separate decisions not to inspect, not one inflated choice. process_violations remains readable as a shortcut frequency.
part_D_counts_are_NOT_auto_correlated.remedy_assessment: The proposed remedies (cascade-corrected violation ONSETS, or a binary any-violation indicator) are NOT NEEDED and should NOT be adopted. Adopting them would discard real information: the difference between a subject who lapses once and recovers (1) and one who abandons the procedure entirely (4) is exactly the signal we want. No V-criterion needs amending on this ground.

part_E_NEW_FINDING_shortcut_is_budget_ne.observation: The one-shortcut-then-recover path costs EXACTLY 13 actions - identical to the fully compliant path (13). The shortcut saves one verify (B1 not inspected before reserving) but then wastes one re-inspecting B1. Net budget gain from a single shortcut: ZERO.
part_E_NEW_FINDING_shortcut_is_budget_ne.contrast: A subject who commits to never inspecting route B pays 4 (explore A) + 4 (reserves) + 1 (report) = 9 actions, saving 4.
part_E_NEW_FINDING_shortcut_is_budget_ne.consequence_for_the_instrument: The budget-pressure gradient rewards ALL-OR-NOTHING shortcutting. A single violation buys the subject nothing, so a budget-rational subject has no incentive to take exactly one. process_violations is therefore likely to be BIMODAL (0 or 4), not graded.
part_E_NEW_FINDING_shortcut_is_budget_ne.threat: Any V-criterion or analysis expecting a GRADED distribution of process_violations across trials may be mis-specified. Also, with 4 segments the per-trial count has effectively 2 realistic values, so a 20-trial pilot yields far less resolution on violation FREQUENCY than the spec's framing implies.
part_E_NEW_FINDING_shortcut_is_budget_ne.severity: MEDIUM - does not threaten the validity bar directly (the bar is about chosen-vs-forced, which holds), but it does threaten the informativeness of the primary outcome. Must be in the synthesis and in not_checked for the analysis plan.
part_E_NEW_FINDING_shortcut_is_budget_ne.flagged_by: lead_experimentalist; NOT previously identified by the PI, the spec, or any member.

not_checked: Whether confound_hunter_design independently replicates any of this (in flight at time of writing).
Seeds other than 1 (Route B is invariantly [12.0]*4 so the cost arithmetic is seed-independent, but this was not swept).
Hard-violation cascades on Route A (where a re-inspection could reveal the over-limit segment mid-recovery).
Whether a subject that shortcuts on route A rather than B faces different recovery economics.
Any model-subject behaviour. All static enumeration.
